assessments.reasoning: On printed and physical page 16, §10.2 specifies globally declared procedures bound to a record type declared in the same module, with the receiver preceding the identifier in the ProcedureHeading production. The opening prose pairs a variable parameter with the record type and a value parameter with POINTER TO the record type. The Receiver production shows the VAR position, while the prose establishes the allowed mode and type pairings.

challenge.method: Check swapped receiver modes, receiver position, nested procedures, foreign-module record types, and ordinary procedures with no receiver against both §10.2 prose and productions.
challenge.results: The described binding pairs VAR with a record and value mode with a pointer to that record. The report limits the binding to this module’s record type. The receiver is optional in the general heading grammar, and the claim’s condition restricts its statement to bound procedures.

limitations: The receiver finding describes the frozen report grammar and accompanying prose. Compiler variants and full-program validation require separate evidence.
